From 1 July 2026, Support Services Level 1 earns $26.97/hour ($1,024.70/week), Level 2 earns $28.03/hour ($1,065.20/week), Level 3 earns $29.11/hour ($1,106.20/week), Level 4 earns $29.45/hour ($1,119.10/week), and Level 5 earns $30.45/hour ($1,157.20/week).

Under MA000027, Saturday work pays 150% of the minimum hourly rate for full-time and part-time employees, and 175% for casuals (which includes the 25% casual loading).

Overtime under MA000027 is paid at 150% of the minimum hourly rate for the first 2 hours and 200% after that.
